relations.subject: Adam Hardy
relations.object: Welsh School of Architecture, Cardiff University
relations.evidence: Professor Adam Hardy is an architect and architectural historian, and Professor of Asian Architecture at the Welsh School of Architecture, Cardiff University.

relations.subject: Adam Hardy
relations.evidence: He is Director of PRASADA, a centre bringing together research and practice in South Asian art and architecture.

relations.subject: Adam Hardy
relations.evidence: He was educated at the Royal Grammar School, High Wycombe (1965–71) and Trinity College, Cambridge.
